info.name: LNG Web BE - Auth RBAC
info.description: Auth RBAC endpoints for local POD FBM backend testing. Authorization is stored through AccessAssignment; ScopedRolePermission is the canonical scoped override model.

request.description: Requires AUTH_REGISTER_ENABLED=true. Creates a USER account with transactional Account + UserProfile + global AccessAssignment writes.
Rotates the refresh token and updates collection variables.
Requires AUTH:READ. Captures the first account id into accountId.
Requires AUTH:READ. Captures ADMIN into roleId, plus operatorRoleId, teamLeaderRoleId, and departmentManagerRoleId for demo scoped RBAC requests.
Requires AUTH:READ. Captures the first permission id into permissionId.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Use roleId from List Roles; creates global AccessAssignment records and captures the created account id.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Updates Account and UserProfile email in one transaction and invalidates old sessions/tokens.
Use carefully in local testing because it changes the account password.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Soft archives the account instead of hard deleting it.
Requires valid roleId and permissionId from List Roles/List Permissions. Replaces active global AccessAssignment records for the account.
Requires AUTH:READ. Lists registered team/department/shop/vendor scopes and captures the first scopeRegistryId.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Register the scope before creating team/department/shop/vendor access assignments.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Registers demo department scope for visual RBAC testing.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Registers demo team scope for visual RBAC testing.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Registers demo team scope for visual RBAC testing.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Registers demo shop scope for visual RBAC testing.

item.name: Create Demo Pet Memorial Shop Scope

request.description: Requires AUTH:WRITE. Registers demo shop scope for visual RBAC testing.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Only name/status are editable; scopeType and scopeId are immutable.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Soft-deactivates the scope. Rejected while active access assignments use it.
Requires AUTH:READ. Captures the first assignment id into assignmentId.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Assigns a role to an account in one scope such as team or department. Scoped team/department/shop/vendor values must exist as active ScopeRegistry entries.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Deactivates the assignment instead of hard deleting it.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Creates Department Manager Demo with baseline USER global role, then use the next request to assign scoped access.

item.name: Assign Department Manager To Operations Department

request.description: Requires AUTH:WRITE. Assigns departmentManagerRoleId inside department:departmentScopeId.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Creates Team Leader Demo with baseline USER global role, then use the next request to assign scoped access.

item.name: Assign Team Leader To Sales Team

request.description: Requires AUTH:WRITE. Assigns teamLeaderRoleId inside team:salesTeamScopeId.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Creates Shop User Demo with baseline USER global role, then use the next request to assign scoped access.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Assigns operatorRoleId inside shop:footballShopScopeId.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Adds one permission to role with $addToSet and invalidates affected account auth cache.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Removes one permission from role with $pull and invalidates affected account auth cache.
Returns 409 if this role is assigned to any account.
Invalidates auth cache for accounts using this permission through AccessAssignment custom permissions or through roles.
Returns 409 if the permission is assigned through AccessAssignment custom permissions or used by any role.

item.name: Scoped Role Permissions
item.description: Canonical scoped role permission override APIs. Use scopeType department for department-specific overrides.

request.description: Requires AUTH:READ. Lists scoped role permission overrides by scopeType, scopeId, and roleId.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Replaces the role permission list for one exact team scoped role override.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Canonical replacement for department-specific role permission matrix writes.
Requires AUTH:READ. Captures first departmentId.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Creates department and syncs auth ScopeRegistry.
Requires AUTH:READ. Captures first teamId.
Requires AUTH:WRITE. Creates team under active department and syncs auth ScopeRegistry.
Requires AUTH:READ. Demo expectation: leaders J2506-J2509, members J2514-J2522.
Requires AUTH:READ. Demo expectation: leaders J2510-J2513, members J2523-J2530.

Requires global AUTH:WRITE or scoped TEAMS:WRITE for the target team department. Accepts exactly one of accountId or employeeCode. memberType can be leader or member; organization syncs team-scoped auth assignments.
Requires global AUTH:WRITE or scoped TEAMS:WRITE for the target team department. Soft-removes membership and deactivates team-scoped auth assignments.
